items.text: Commanders ruled out QB Jayden Daniels with left elbow injury. Last time missed four games. Later: dislocated, X-rays no fracture, additional testing Monday.
items.why: Dislocated left elbow mid-game, carted, ruled out
items.implication: Sit rest of day/ROS short-term; backup QB elevated
items.opportunity: Commanders pass catchers/backup QB volume if extended

items.text: Bears say Caleb Williams suffered a hamstring injury. Later reports: walking under own power, slight limp, tests Monday, good spirits.
items.opportunity: CHI backup QB and skill if out

items.text: Ladd McConkey officially ACTIVE. RJ Harvey inactive. Grab Jonah Coleman now if ignored preseason.
items.implication: Lock McConkey; add Coleman as handcuff/beneficiary
items.opportunity: Coleman role expansion in DEN backfield

items.text: Broncos RB RJ Harvey is inactive today.
items.opportunity: Increased carries/snaps for backups like Coleman

items.text: Bengals QB Joe Burrow officially active vs Texans (was Q). Also Olave active, Tua inactive, McMillan active.
items.why: Official active after back issue, expected to play

items.text: Sunday injuries watching: Caleb Williams (hamstring), Jayden Daniels (dislocated left elbow), Saquon Barkley (stinger), Jadarian Price (chest), Jayden Reed (head), Jonathon Brooks (groin), Rico Dowdle (toe), JK Dobbins (hamstring), Dallas Goedert (knee), Mike Evans (hip, not serious), others.
items.implication: Monday testing critical for several; handcuffs elevated

items.text: Seahawks rookie RB Jadarian Price is questionable to return due to a chest injury.
items.implication: Monitor; potential limited or out rest of game

items.text: 49ers WR Mike Evans has a hip injury and is questionable to return today.
items.implication: Monitor return; not expected serious per later ETR

items.text: Packers ruled out WR Jayden Reed (neck) and RT Zach Bako-Bewele (knee).
items.implication: Sit Reed; other GB WRs up

items.text: Eagles say RB Saquon Barkley (stinger) is questionable to return today.
items.opportunity: Gainwell or other PHI RB if limited/out

items.text: Zay Flowers injury opens door for Rashod Bateman; without Flowers Ravens need big game from him.

Projecting Ladd McConkey in with decent injury docks (RapSheet bullish, status late); Puka Nacua true GTD; Chris Olave clean no docks; decent look at Jonah Coleman if RJ Harvey out; Germie Bernard look with Michael Pittman out.
items.why: Rap tone bullish on McConkey; practice/reports clean for Olave; depth for outs
items.implication: Start McConkey/Olave with caution docks; stash/monitor Coleman/Bernard

items.text: Weekend reports summary: GTD Ladd McConkey (cracked rib, optimism, flak jacket) and Puka Nacua (hip); not expected RJ Harvey (hamstring); expected Chris Olave (hamstring), Joe Burrow (back), Kaelon Black (groin), Jalen McMillan (knee, snap count); OUT Zay Flowers (hamstring), Michael Pittman (foot).
items.implication: Key for lineup locks and handcuffs
items.opportunity: Role expansion for backups behind outs

items.text: Rams consider WR Puka Nacua (hip, Q for MNF vs Giants) a pre-game decision.
items.why: Hip, missed practices, extra time to MNF
items.implication: True GTD; have backup ready for MNF
items.opportunity: Adams or other LAR WRs if out

items.text: Agrees with Germie Bernard stash (YAC man, Pittman out, good fit with McCarthy); also Sarratt with Lane out and Flowers hamstring.
items.why: Pittman foot out opens Bernard; Flowers opens others
items.implication: Deep league add Bernard for potential targets
